name: BoMed AutoBook Agent
description: Autonomous healthcare appointment scheduling agent. Finds optimal appointment slots based on patient-defined scheduling policies (allowed hours, days, buffer time, weekly limits). Manages permission requests, monitors vital signs, and coordinates between patients and healthcare providers. All operations are permission-gated through Bolospot's live trust graph — patients retain full control with instant revocation.

authentication.credentials: Bolospot API key (practice-side) or patient JWT

skills.name: Schedule Appointment
skills.description: Find the next available appointment slot matching the patient's scheduling policy and book it. Respects constraints: min buffer time, allowed hours/days, weekly max. Returns a FHIR Appointment resource.
examples: Book a PT session for @patient within their policy constraints
Find the next available slot for a follow-up with Acme Physical Therapy

skills.name: Manage Healthcare Permissions
skills.description: Handle permission grants and revocations between patients and providers. Supports granular scopes: appointments, vitals, insurance, demographics, records. Returns FHIR Consent resources.
examples: Grant @acme-pt read access to appointments and vitals

skills.name: Monitor Vital Signs
skills.description: Read and record patient vital signs through the permission-gated relay. Supports temperature, heart rate, SpO2, and blood pressure. Returns FHIR Observation resources.
examples: Record temperature reading of 98.6°F from Ladybug.bot

skills.name: Propagate Insurance Information
skills.description: Share insurance coverage details with authorized providers. Requires insurance:transmit grant. Returns FHIR Coverage resource.
